STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_029388.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_029388.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_029388 (
    input pixelclk,
    input reset_n,

    input [23:0] i_rgb,
    input        i_hsync,
    input        i_vsync,
    input        i_de,

    input [11:0] hcount,
    input [11:0] vcount,

    input [11:0] hcount_l,
    input [11:0] hcount_r,
    input [11:0] vcount_l,
    input [11:0] vcount_r,

    output [23:0] o_rgb,
    output        o_hsync,
    output        o_vsync,
    output        o_de
);

  reg [23:0] rgb_r;
  reg        hsync_r;
  reg        vsync_r;
  reg        de_r;

  always @(posedge pixelclk) begin
    hsync_r <= i_hsync;
    vsync_r <= i_vsync;
    de_r    <= i_de;
  end

  assign o_hsync = hsync_r;
  assign o_vsync = vsync_r;
  assign o_de    = de_r;
  assign o_rgb   = rgb_r;
  //-------------------------------------------------------------
  // Display
  //-------------------------------------------------------------
  always @(posedge pixelclk or negedge reset_n) begin
    if (!reset_n) rgb_r <= 24'h000000;
    else if (vcount > vcount_l && vcount < vcount_r && ( hcount == hcount_l || hcount == hcount_r || hcount == (hcount_l -1) || hcount == (hcount_r+1)))
      rgb_r <= 24'hff00aa;
    else if (hcount > hcount_l && hcount < hcount_r && (vcount== vcount_l || vcount== vcount_r || vcount==( vcount_l - 1) || vcount== (vcount_r + 1)))
      rgb_r <= 24'hff00aa;
    else rgb_r <= i_rgb;
  end

endmodule
